title: Nucleosynthesis
description: Every element heavier than helium was made in a star. Iron is where fusion stops; supernovae make the rest.

puzzle.goal: Inside a star at temperature T, two nuclei of reduced mass μ must tunnel through their Coulomb barrier to fuse. Their cross-section is S(E)/E times a tunnelling factor exp(−√(E_G/E)). Average the cross-section times relative speed over the thermal distribution of energies E.
puzzle.name: Thermonuclear reaction rate with the Gamow peak
puzzle.form: sqrt ( 8 / ( π * μ ) ) * ( kB * T ) ^ ( - 3 / 2 ) * int ( 0 , ∞ , S * exp ( - E / ( kB * T ) - sqrt ( E _ G / E ) ) , E )
puzzle.ask: The integrand peaks sharply where E/kT + √(EG/E) is smallest, at E0 = (EG(kT)²/4)^(1/3). Find this peak energy for proton-proton fusion in the Sun's core.
puzzle.method: Multiply the cross-section by the speed and the thermal distribution of energies; the tunnelling and thermal factors combine into one exponential.
